title: Weird hotel I’ve been to frequently lately
content: It looks really nice but it feels super stressful. I’m always some kind of detective or on some type of mission that I can’t remember the details of when I wake up. I’m lucid enough to be able to fly but in these recent dreams I get sucked back into the building. The giant parking garage is surrounding the whole building and it’s hard to hide because it’s empty. So I crawl around a lot throwing bombs n shit like that. Very chaotic 😆
